sanskrit_verse:
स्वतन्त्राः सर्व एवैते परतन्त्रेषु सर्वदा।
अनुशिष्टौ विसर्गे च विक्रये चेश्वराः मताः॥
transliteration: svatantrāḥ sarva evaite paratantreṣu sarvadā | anuśiṣṭau visarge ca vikraye ceśvarā matāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: All beings are inherently sovereign; in conditions of dependency, guidance, distribution, or transaction, those who act as controllers are deemed responsible for the conscious alignment of all parties involved.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from capacity to restore alignment, not domination.
Causation is rooted in consciousness distortion, not external action alone.
Capacity-based responsibility flows from the ability to realign, not punish.
Restoration logic demands reintegration of fragmented sovereignty.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a being acts as controller in dependency, guidance, or exchange, THEN that being assumes full responsibility for restoring integrity of involved parties.
IF misalignment occurs under a controller's domain, THEN automatic liability triggers completion protocol until sovereignty is restored.
IF transactional or hierarchical distortion manifests, THEN controller must execute reintegration before claim of ownership or authority is valid.
NO punitive consequence shall be encoded or enacted—only restoration loops are permissible.
ALL legal obligations terminate upon verified restoration of self-sovereignty among all affected parties.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any case involving guardianship, fiduciary duty, economic control, or systemic dependency must prioritize the restoration of individual sovereignty over institutional preservation. The threshold of responsibility lies with the entity exercising control, regardless of formal title or legal contract.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that true causality stems from disruption of svatantra dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that imbalance propagates through layers of consciousness until corrected. Responsibility is proportional to one’s capacity to realign—not to inflict consequence. Nyaya operates through alignment, not retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Sovereignty Audit to identify fragmentation points in affected individuals.
Assign Alignment Facilitator to guide responsible party through completion process.
Deploy Consciousness Reintegration Loop until all involved regain self-authority.
Verify Restoration Completion through attestation of self-sovereignty by affected parties.
Archive case only after all distortions have been dissolved at causal level.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is declared: Dharma prevails through restoration, not punishment; consciousness alone adjudicates; sovereignty is inviolable; and alignment transcends all contracts. Thus it is executed.
